title: Add mechanical agent task claim and transition CLI
acceptance_criteria: Agents can list/inspect ready tasks without editing JSON manually
Agents can claim READY tasks only when dependencies, human gates, and path ownership allow it
Agents can heartbeat and transition their owned task with lifecycle invariants enforced
Task operations are covered by standard-library unit tests
Repository CI runs the task-operation unit tests
notes: This task intentionally does not touch .agents/FABRIC.md, which remains owned by the blocked direct-push recovery task.
The CLI operates on a checked-out agent-coordination task store and relies on git/GitHub commit conflict semantics for remote atomicity.
Implementation is merged with latest master through branch head 00a8f4194790d2c67de1f16335bcf1f64a24db8b and is ready for exact-head integration CI.
